title: NHK Documentary — 歌舞伎の世界 (The World of Kabuki)
description: An in-depth NHK documentary on kabuki theater — Japan's classical drama form recognized as UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage. Traces kabuki from Izumo no Okuni's 17th-century street performances through the onnagata (male actors in female roles) tradition and the demanding multi-year training process of modern kabuki actors.
creator: NHK
